# .github/workflows/

GitHub Actions workflows for site generation and deployment.

## Workflows

| File | Triggers | Purpose |
|------|----------|---------|
| `generate-preview.yml` | `repository_dispatch` (type: new-wedding), `workflow_dispatch` | Generates preview with 10 original theme variants. Saves wedding data JSON to gh-pages for later use by final generation. |
| `generate-final.yml` | `repository_dispatch` (type: theme-selected), `workflow_dispatch` | Generates final published site. Supports both original themes (`classic`) and 2026 layouts (`envelope/velvet`). Cleans up preview folder and wedding data after generation. |
| `deploy-pages.yml` | Push to `main` affecting `public/**` | Deploys static content (landing page, showcase, form) to GitHub Pages. |

## Security

- All inputs validated with regex before use
- Slug: `^[a-z0-9-]+$`
- Theme: `^[a-z0-9-]+(/[a-z0-9-]+)?$` (supports `layout/theme` format)
- Inputs passed via `env:` blocks, never `${{ }}` interpolation in `run:` steps
- Uses `peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4` for deployment
